entities.name: Q2JTG5
observations: Reviewed UniProt protein from Synechococcus sp.; exact sequence match to the submitted 353-aa sequence; annotated as histidinol-phosphate aminotransferase (EC 2.6.1.9).
PLP-dependent enzyme in the L-histidine biosynthesis pathway.

entities.name: RHEA:23744
observations: L-histidinol phosphate + 2-oxoglutarate = 3-(imidazol-4-yl)-2-oxopropyl phosphate + L-glutamate; annotated for EC 2.6.1.9.

entities.name: PLP (CHEBI:597326)
observations: Pyridoxal 5'-phosphate is annotated as the cofactor for Q2JTG5 histidinol-phosphate aminotransferase.
